ascendancies.notes: Deadeye dominates — chain from Ricochet, +2 proj from Endless Munitions, Tailwind from Gathering Winds. Each extra projectile creates more secondary projectiles. Pathfinder for MF/juice. Champion for tanky variant with Fortify.

gear_priorities.weapon: High pDPS bow for phys conversion builds, or flat ele for ele TS. Endgame: +2 arrow rare Thicket Bow is S-tier. Death's Opus is a strong budget option (+2 arrows). Mirror-tier: triple damage bow.
gear_priorities.quiver: +1 arrow is king on quiver — each arrow spawns secondary projectiles. Life, crit multi, flat damage. Rigwald's Quills for fork (insane clear but expensive).
gear_priorities.helmet: Rare with life, res, -9% nearby res (matching your damage type). TS enchant: +2 secondary projectiles is build-defining.
gear_priorities.body_armour: Hyrri's Ire budget. Endgame: Farruls Fur or rare with life + crit + suppression.
gear_priorities.gloves: Gripped Gloves (proj implicit). Life, attack speed, flat damage, res.
gear_priorities.boots: Rare with life, movespeed, res, spell suppression. Tailwind boots if not Deadeye.
gear_priorities.amulet: Crystallised Omniscience for omni variant. Otherwise: crit multi, flat damage, +1 phys/lightning gems.
gear_priorities.rings: Flat damage to attacks, life, res. Mark of the Elder combo endgame. Essence of Wrath craft for flat lightning.
gear_priorities.belt: Stygian Vise — life, elemental damage, res. Headhunter/Mageblood for absolute endgame juice.
gear_priorities.flasks: Dying Sun is CORE (+2 proj = more secondary explosions). Diamond Flask. Bottled Faith endgame.

gem_links.bossing_swap: Some players run a separate Barrage 6L for single target in weapon swap. Otherwise swap GMP for Damage on Full Life.
gem_links.utility: Sniper's Mark for bosses. Blood Rage for frenzy charges.
gem_links.guard: Molten Shell or Steelskin depending on armour/evasion balance.

tree_priorities: All bow clusters: King of the Hill, Ballistic Mastery, Fury Bolts, Master Fletcher
Crit clusters: Depth Perception, Assassination, Heartseeker
Life wheels: Herbalism, Constitution, Thick Skin
Projectile damage: Forces of Nature, Point Blank (optional — bad for clear, good for bosses)
breakpoints: Dying Sun + GMP + ascendancy = 9+ projectiles for screen-wide clear
Helmet enchant +2 secondary projectiles — doubles the overlap potential
+1 arrow on bow AND quiver — each arrow creates independent secondary proj explosions
common_mistakes: Thinking more projectiles only helps clear — in TS, more arrows = more secondary projectile overlap = more single target too, unlike LA.
Skipping Dying Sun — it's not optional for TS, +2 proj is a massive multiplier for both clear and single target.
Not getting the helmet enchant — +2 secondary projectiles is one of the biggest DPS increases in the game for TS.
Using Point Blank for mapping — it guts your clear since secondary projectiles travel away from you. Only use for dedicated bossing.
Investing in % increased damage instead of flat damage + crit multi — TS scales from raw projectile count and crit, not % increases.
scaling_tips: TS is unique: each arrow that hits the ground creates 3 secondary projectiles. More arrows = exponentially more coverage. The helmet enchant (+2 secondary) and +arrow sources (bow, quiver, Dying Sun, ascendancy) are your biggest multipliers. Stack flat damage and crit multi, not % increased.
